source.campaign_title_visible: Katy, TX — Estate Sale Online Auction — Local Treasures. Real Value.

classification.event_product_type: Geographic event promotion — a Katy, TX estate-sale online auction, generic (no date, seller or lots)

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Logo → 'KATY, TX' spaced caps (small) → 'ESTATE SALE' (red, largest) / 'ONLINE AUCTION' (navy) → 'Local Treasures. Real Value.' + red swash → three red icons → red CTA 'VIEW AUCTION →' → navy band (Shop Local / Bid Confidently / Real Treasures) + 'You Can Do This.' → footer strip. Right: the Katy water tower and a 'Welcome to KATY' banner, furniture staged outdoors (leather armchair, lamp, chest, bronze horse, books, bluebonnet painting, chalkboard 'Great Finds Local Style.').
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Outdoor staged vignette in front of a town landmark.
visual_read.composition_style: Copy column left; landmark + merchandise right; band closes.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Uppercase condensed; event type in red; place name small spaced caps; script accent.
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: Merchandise staged on a rug on a town green; water tower behind.

strongest_attributes: WHAT ('Estate Sale / Online Auction') is the loudest thing on the page; WHERE is carried twice — a small place line and an unmistakable landmark
Local identity through a real-world landmark rather than a map
Red event type over navy sub-type — the Owner's red-attention rule on the event type
transferable_lessons: Geographic creative: event type largest; place as a spaced-caps eyebrow AND an environmental landmark cue
Landmark imagery is acceptable for GENERIC geographic promotion; a real event prefers its own photographs (3P.1 media hierarchy)
'Shop Local' as a band item is buyer-facing geographic language
do_not_generalize: No date or time — a real geographic event creative must carry WHEN
The water tower and banner — a specific town's landmarks; never reused for another place; never generated for a real event when authentic media exists

The collaborator's set repeats a bronze rearing horse, a blue-and-white vase, a stack of books with category-name spines, a gilt landscape, a laptop showing the logo and a handwritten script phrase on a mug/board/box. These are the collaborator's props, not required objects; the engine must not learn them as a checklist.

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: Event type dominance carries the page.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: For a real event: EVENT profile (5–7 blocks) with WHEN mandatory.

composition_assessment.gravity_and_grounding: Furniture on a rug on the ground.
composition_assessment.depth: Tower far, chair mid, horse/painting front.
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Chair anchor; tower as scale of place.

avoid_for: real events with authentic media (use the photographs)

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection at full resolution; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* are visual estimates; text transcribed from the image and classified.

text_classification.note: acceptable when the destination is the real auction
